text:
Before the meal, the tray held a plate of fried rice with vegetables and some meat, plus a chocolate-wrapped bar. By the end, the plate was nearly empty, with only a little residue left, and the bar wrapper had a wooden stick in it. The stick suggests the bar was an ice cream bar, so it was probably eaten.

For the rice, I estimated the portion at about 300 g. Fried rice with meat and vegetables is roughly 1.6 kcal/g, which gives about 480 kcal. I assumed about 95% was eaten, so about 285 g and 450 kcal.

For the bar, a chocolate-coated ice cream bar weighs about 60 g and has roughly 200 kcal.

Adding the two gives about 345 g and about 650 kcal.

{"kcal": 650, "mass_g": 345}
